changes.title: Plan obligations and audit tool evidence

title: Improve ReactAgent planning and finalization
summary:
Strengthens `ReactAgent.run` to reduce premature or incomplete task completion.

- Adds a bounded actionability audit and stronger resource discovery guidance.
- Adds obligation and channel planning with dynamic tool-evidence audits, including corrective re-audits.
- Improves one motivating task while preserving regression outcomes.
- Adds focused regression coverage; tests were not run per instruction.
